glowthread-ui-admin-setting-new-account-: Comments from accounts younger than this wait for review, unless the account already has enough visible comments. 0 turns the gate off.
Visible comments that skip the gate
A new account with at least this many visible comments posts without review.
glowthread-ui-admin-setting-auto-hold-re: A visible comment is held for review once this many different users report it. Reports from its author and from blocked users do not count. 0 turns it off.
glowthread-ui-admin-setting-report-reaso: Readers pick one of these when they report a comment. Keep at least one.
glowthread-ui-admin-setting-max-length-h: The longest comment readers can post, in characters. An emoji counts as one.
glowthread-ui-admin-setting-max-mentions: How many different users one comment may @mention.
glowthread-ui-admin-setting-duplicate-wi: How long the same user must wait before posting the same text on the same page again.
glowthread-ui-admin-setting-public-log-h: Show moderation actions and settings changes to everyone in Special:Log, Special:RecentChanges and watchlists. When this is off, only moderators and administrators see them, and actions taken meanwhile send no watchlist emails or notifications. CheckUser records them either way.
glowthread-ui-admin-setting-range-error: Enter a whole number from $1 to $2.
glowthread-ui-admin-setting-range-off-er: Enter $1 to turn it off, or a whole number from $2 to $3.
glowthread-ui-admin-settings-rate-help: Set by the site operators in LocalSettings.php ($wgRateLimits) and shown here for reference only. Administrators are not limited, except where noted.
glowthread-ui-admin-filter-help: One rule per line. Plain text matches whole words, ignoring case and accents: spam catches “Spam!”, “spàm” and “s p a m” but not “spammer”, and a rule of several words also matches with other spaces or symbols between its words, or none. Text written with accents matches only the same accents. Plain text in Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Lao, Khmer or Myanmar matches anywhere, even with spaces or symbols between its characters, but not across a line break, full-width punctuation such as 。 and ，, or brackets and quotes such as 「」. /pattern/flags is a regular expression (flags i, m, s, x). Lines starting with # are comments. At most 2000 rules are used. A match holds the comment for review, it is never rejected.
glowthread-ui-admin-filter-readonly: You can read the rules. Editing them needs the right to edit interface pages (editinterface), and testing them needs the right to change comment settings (glowthread-configure).
